capability_being_tested: Calibration of a blind forecast of the pair's own delegated outcome; a diagnostic reported beside SA, never a rung.
testing_benchmark: SA-cal blind forecast over the Core's delegation families
benchmark_witness: Before each delegated episode the pair writes forecast.json {p_pass} without doing the task; the episode then runs and is verified.
experimental_intervention: The task is forbidden at forecast time; the verdict is unavailable until after.

hidden_or_grounded_state.outcome: the verifier's verdict on the episode

procedure: collect the forecast with the task forbidden
compare with the post-hoc constant forecast at the pair's base rate
report beside SA with a bounded bonus
controls_or_ablations: post-hoc constant forecast at the base rate
external_verifier: score.sacal_pass over the Core's domain families
